## What it is

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> A trip to Scienceworks not only provides a safe environment for the little ones to explore but also gives you answers to questions you have taken for granted as an adult. It is never too late to learn about the world!
>
> In a single visit, guests have the chance to learn about the machines that once fueled the city.
